    EndGameState.onEntry()
    Applies end-game building effects, tallies builder/inventor/artist/building bonuses for each player, persists the match via GameDAO, and broadcasts final results and the leaderboard.
    ControllerState
    EndRoundState.onEntry()
    Shifts the top row into the lower row, refills the top row from the deck, handles era transitions (swapping building decks when the deck crosses an era boundary), and advances the round counter.
    ControllerState
    EventsState.onEntry()
    Resolves all lower-row events, and on round 10 also the upper-row events, then transitions to the next phase.
    ControllerState
    ExtraMoveState.onEntry()
    Evaluates end-of-round building effects and either selects the lone player with an extra-move bonus as current player, or skips straight to EventsState if no player has the bonus.
    ControllerState
    InitGameState.onEntry()
    Builds the Board (rows, decks, order tile) from the loaded configuration, places players on the order tile in random order, grants each player their starting food bonus based on order position, and marks the game as initialised.
    ControllerState
    RecoverState.onEntry()
    Notifies connected clients of the lobby state and clears the stop flag so the state machine keeps waiting for reconnections.
    ControllerState
    TotemPickingState.onEntry()
    Computes which totems are still available (accounting for players that may already have a colour set after recovery), broadcasts the available list, and persists the game.
    ControllerState
    TotemPlacementState.onEntry()
    If no current player is set (start of round or recovery), selects the first player still present on the OrderTile and notifies clients of the updated game state.
